name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Renamed from A Smokywood Pastures Thank You!. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, adventurer.  For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Great-father Winter himself!

Please, speak with Great-father Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures.  From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!
narrative.objectives: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ho ho hello, adventurer!The goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you.  Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 60, 9,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
quests.objectiveText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: You're a Mean One...
quests.objectiveText: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
